title: Player Unknown's Battleground (PUBG)
description: PUBG Mobile is a pioneering battle royale experience that pits 100 players against each other in a struggle for survival. Land, loot, and outwit your opponents to become the last person standing. With continuous updates and new game modes like the recent Frost Survival Mode and various Arena modes, the game offers intense, strategic, and thrilling gameplay across huge, diverse maps like Erangel and Miramar. It emphasizes tactical positioning, teamwork, and inventory management alongside high-stakes shooting mechanics, ensuring every match is a unique, edge-of-your-seat experience. The game is known for its realistic graphics and continuous e-sports support.

minimumSpecs.GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R7 370

recommendedSpecs.GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580

title: Valorant
description: Valorant is a 5v5 character-based tactical shooter where precision gunplay meets unique agent abilities. Choose from a diverse cast of Agents, each with unique skills, to gain a competitive edge. The game emphasizes tactical planning, fast reflexes, and teamwork, requiring players to master map layouts and economic management. With its high tick-rate servers and robust anti-cheat system, Valorant delivers a top-tier, competitive FPS experience.

title: GTA V
description: Grand Theft Auto V is an expansive and critically acclaimed open-world action-adventure game set in the sprawling city of Los Santos. Players take control of three diverse protagonists—Michael, Franklin, and Trevor—whose lives intertwine as they execute daring heists. The game features a massive, detailed map for exploration, complex mission structures, and the incredibly popular, constantly evolving online component, GTA Online.

minimumSpecs.CPU: Intel Core 2 Quad Q6600 / AMD Phenom 9850

recommendedSpecs.CPU: Intel Core i5 3470 / AMD X8 FX-8350

title: Minecraft
description: Minecraft is the ultimate sandbox game about placing blocks and going on adventures. Explore randomly generated worlds, survive dangerous mobs at night, and build anything imaginable—from simple homes to grand castles. The game offers two primary modes: Creative Mode, where players have unlimited resources, and Survival Mode, where players must acquire resources, build to stay safe, and maintain health and hunger.

minimumSpecs.GPU: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / Radeon R5 series

recommendedSpecs.GPU: NVIDIA GeForce 700 series / AMD Radeon Rx 200 series

title: Fortnite
description: Fortnite is a global cultural phenomenon known for its unique blend of Battle Royale shooting and building mechanics. Players drop onto an island, scavenge for weapons, and eliminate opponents while a storm shrinks the playable area. The building aspect adds a layer of strategic depth, allowing players to quickly construct shelters and defenses. Fortnite is constantly evolving with seasonal content, events, and collaborations.

recommendedSpecs.GPU: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280 or equivalent DX11 GPU

title: Call of Duty: Mobile
description: Call of Duty: Mobile brings the iconic FPS franchise experience to your smartphone. The game features classic multiplayer modes like Team Deathmatch and Search & Destroy on legendary maps (e.g., Shipment, Nuketown), as well as a full Battle Royale mode. It offers high-quality console-level graphics, customizable controls, and competitive seasonal ranking, making it one of the most popular mobile shooters globally.

title: League of Legends
description: League of Legends (LoL) is the world's most popular MOBA (Multiplayer Online Battle Arena) game. Two teams of five powerful champions, each with a unique design and playstyle, clash across three lanes to destroy the enemy's Nexus. The game demands deep strategy, quick decision-making, and coordinated team play. LoL is the pinnacle of e-sports, featuring massive global tournaments and a continuously expanding roster of champions.

recommendedSpecs.CPU: Intel Core i5-3300 / AMD Ryzen 5 1000 series
recommendedSpecs.GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 560 / AMD Radeon HD 6950

title: Among Us
description: Among Us is a social deduction party game set in space. Players are divided into Crewmates and Impostors. Crewmates must complete tasks to keep the ship running, while Impostors secretly sabotage the ship and eliminate the Crewmates. The core gameplay revolves around emergency meetings where players debate and vote to eject suspected Impostors. It’s a game of trust, betrayal, and clever lying.

title: Apex Legends
description: Apex Legends is a free-to-play squad-based Battle Royale shooter where legendary characters, each with their own unique abilities, fight for fame and fortune on the fringes of the Frontier. The game introduces innovative features like the 'Ping System' for easy communication and 'Respawn Beacons' for bringing back fallen teammates, making teamwork essential for victory.

recommendedSpecs.GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is a massive, story-driven open-world RPG set in a morally indifferent fantasy universe. You are Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter for hire. The game features breathtaking landscapes, deep character development, impactful narrative choices, and a robust combat system involving swords and magic. It is widely considered one of the greatest RPGs ever made, offering hundreds of hours of immersive gameplay.

minimumSpecs.CPU: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD Phenom II X4 940
minimumSpecs.GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870

recommendedSpecs.GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 / AMD Radeon R9 290
